I'd like to ask for your help again next time.
The treatment and service are always excellent, and I appreciate the careful attention to detail. I also really appreciate that they look after my pet before and after the treatment.

Thank you so much.

I will definitely visit the shop again.

This was my first time using their service.

They listened carefully to my requests regarding the grooming design and I was able to communicate them clearly. They also kept me updated on the progress via LINE and sent cute photos, which I really appreciated! The free pet-sitting service was also a great help!

I come here every month. 🙇‍♀️
I started going here because I saw a cute cut on Instagram. They always provide a thorough consultation and trim, so I can leave my dog ​​in their care with peace of mind. ✨

I love how they suggest cuts based on the dog's coat type and personality, and the results are always so cute, I'm always very satisfied. 🥰
They take lots of adorable photos, and I always look forward to the photo booth, which changes every month. ♪

They offer free care before and after the trim from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, so I can run errands during that time, which is really helpful!

The staff are so kind, so my dog ​​is relaxed and looks forward to coming to the salon. 😆
Thank you for your continued patronage. ✨

I booked an appointment because they offer cat grooming, but the dogs inside were barking constantly, making it a very stressful environment for cats. I think anyone considering bringing a cat should be aware of this. To make matters worse, one of the dogs even escaped through the gate and jumped into the waiting room, which I found dangerous, so I canceled my appointment on the spot.

[Addendum] Regarding this review, I later received a call from the area manager requesting corrections to some inaccuracies in my wording. (× cage → ○ gate) This was an error in my wording, and I have corrected it.

During that call, in response to my intention to describe my concerns and the facts of the experience, they also suggested that I include the fact that, although they normally charge a 100% cancellation fee for same-day cancellations, I was not charged. I have included this in my review. They explained that their business philosophy is to understand the feelings of pet owners, and they seem to handle same-day cancellations like this accordingly.

Incidentally, when I went to the store and told the staff that I wanted to cancel, there was no apology or any consideration for the owner's feelings; they just said "Oh, okay," and there was no explanation about cancellation fees at that time.

Thank you so much for choosing Cheriwanju Shiba store and for your 5-star rating! 🐶🌟
All of our staff are incredibly happy that you entrusted your precious dog to our care. ☺️
We will continue to prioritize your dog's feelings and pace, striving to provide careful grooming and customer service so that they can relax and feel at ease. 🫧
We look forward to seeing you again soon! 💓
I requested a Toy Poodle and it turned out so cute! (^^) I'd love to order from them again!
This was my first time using your service, and I was able to relax and have some fun beforehand. The finished result was beautiful, and I'm very satisfied. I'll definitely use your service again.

I requested a shampoo and haircut for my Yorkshire Terrier.

The booking process was smooth, and the treatment was thorough.
It looks so cute! Thank you!

It was almost as if they did it on purpose, because even though I had requested a beard trim as an option, they didn't do anything to it and returned my dog ​​just as he was. In fact, they didn't trim his face at all; he was literally left as he was when I brought him in, and only his body was shaved with clippers, which was so mismatched I couldn't help but laugh. I think they were in a hurry and forgot about his face. They gave me a very careless response. They probably realized they hadn't done it. I left the shop once, realized what I had done, and went back to politely ask them to trim his beard, and they did, but without any apology. I was rather annoyed that I had to go through the trouble of asking them to do it twice when I had already paid for it. The hair inside his ears was also messy, and I don't understand why I took him all the way there for a cut and shampoo. I had requested it that day, so if they were busy I would have rescheduled, but if they were going to do a shoddy job, I wish they had at least told me. I think the reason the reviews are so good is because you have to write a review in front of them.
This was my first visit, and I was very satisfied with the staff's kindness and the skillful treatment (*´˘`*) I'll definitely be back!
